name: Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport
before:
Michigan's busiest airport by a wide margin, about 18 miles south west of Detroit in Romulus, and the second largest hub for Delta Air Lines. It flies to more than 140 destinations, including 30 international ones and 43 states.

Its reach crosses the border. As well as metropolitan Detroit it serves Ann Arbor, the Toledo area about 40 miles south, Windsor and south western Ontario.

The McNamara Terminal is the big one, with 122 gates across three concourses and used exclusively by Delta, its SkyTeam partners and WestJet. It opened on 24 February 2002 and was the first major airport terminal in the United States to open after the September 11 attacks, replacing the old Davey Terminal as Northwest Airlines' Detroit base.

J.D. Power has named it the best large airport in the United States for customer satisfaction three times, in 2010, 2019 and 2022, which is worth knowing when a client is choosing a connecting point.

Six runways serve the 4,850 acre site, and the maintenance facilities here can handle aircraft as large as a 747-400.
after:
Michigan's busiest airport by a wide margin, about 18 miles south west of Detroit in Romulus. As well as metropolitan Detroit it serves Ann Arbor. It is a hub for Delta Air Lines and handled 33.4 million passengers in 2025.

The McNamara Terminal is the big one, with 122 gates across three concourses. Only four airlines use it: Delta, Aeromexico, Air France and WestJet. It opened on 24 February 2002, the first major airport terminal in the United States to open after the September 11 attacks, and replaced the old Davey Terminal as the Detroit base of Northwest Airlines.

JD Power has ranked the airport first for customer satisfaction among the biggest airports in North America three times, in 2010, 2019 and 2023, which is worth knowing when a client is choosing a connecting point.

Six runways serve the 4,850 acre site.

claims.note: The drafting note asked for the operator's figure. The operator's master plan gives McNamara 122 gates, and Wikipedia's current article gives 122 (Concourse A 64, B 17, C 41). The operator's newest gate count found is that 2017 report; its live FAQ confirms Concourses A, B and C in McNamara and D in the Evans Terminal. Airport-wide totals are cut: the master plan says 147 gates in 2017, Wikipedia both '129 in-service gates' and 'a total of 151 gates'.

claims.note: Was 'the best large airport in the United States ... in 2010, 2019 and 2022'. The operator lists J.D. Power wins in 2010 (large airports, then 30 million passengers or more) and in 2019 and 2023 (mega airports, 33 million or more), each the study's biggest category that year; the third win was 2023, not 2022, and the operator lists none since. J.D. Power's own site answered with a Cloudflare block, so each year is confirmed by the operator and a news report of that year's study. Written 'JD Power', without stops, in the house style used for US and UK.
